description: Transcribe one audio file (up to 15 minutes) with CoreForge Speech (local faster-whisper): transcript text, detected language, duration and word-level segments. Provide an audio URL or base64 audio. Paid via x402 ($0.40 USDC on Base) when a payer wallet is configured; otherwise returns the payment requirements.

audioUrl.description: URL of the audio file to transcribe

filename.description: Filename hint, e.g. interview.mp3 (used with audioBase64)

name: speech_to_text
